text: A report on Bishkek's 327 km border fence (2 November) said the Qara-Chik line is held at nine crossing points. There are ten, with four internal control posts behind them.
headline: Bishkek's 327 km fence is done; Irad's Kyrgyz frontier has no fence and no agreement

text: A report on the Turkic States secretariat (4 November) called the IAC the Irad Autonomous Confederation. It is the Iradi Freedom Society (Iradin Azatlık Cemiyeti).
headline: Uzbek diplomat to lead Turkic States secretariat; Irad has no seat, though all three claimants do

text: A report on Bishkek's 327 km border fence (2 November) gave the length of the Qara-Chik line as about 1,750 km. It is about 1,930 km.
headline: Bishkek's 327 km fence is done; Irad's Kyrgyz frontier has no fence and no agreement
